name: tropomyosin 3

function.text: TPM3 encodes tropomyosin alpha-3 chain. Annotated molecular activities include actin filament binding. It participates in muscle contraction and actin filament organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to TPM3-related myopathy (autosomal dominant); TPM3-related myopathy (autosomal recessive). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-positive histiocytosis; ALK-rearranged renal cell carcinoma; NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
